question: Should ClawHub land this stricter no-case-colliding package-file gate for `SKILL.md`, `skills.md`, and `PROTOCOL.md` now, and require docs/spec plus browser proof before merge?
rationale: Current docs still accept lowercase and legacy readme aliases, while `PROTOCOL.md` is not clearly documented as a ClawHub package contract; accepting the PR is therefore a compatibility and package-policy choice, not only a code correctness decision.

options.title: Document and prove strict gate
options.body: Require docs/spec updates for the no-case-collision rule plus real browser proof of the web upload rejection before merging this implementation.

options.title: Accept code-only compatibility break
options.body: Merge the stricter gate without policy documentation, accepting that some existing colliding packages/import candidates may start failing without published guidance.

options.title: Narrow the package scope
options.body: Defer or remove `PROTOCOL.md` collision enforcement if maintainers only want the current change to cover accepted skill readme aliases.

recommendation.title: Document and prove strict gate
recommendation.body: Require docs/spec updates for the no-case-collision rule plus real browser proof of the web upload rejection before merging this implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is tied to the current package contract and publish-path history, and is also requested for review on the live PR.
